mapper.select: SELECT mr.* FROM meeting_room mr WHERE mr.status = 'AVAILABLE' AND mr.id NOT IN ( SELECT DISTINCT b.room_id FROM booking b WHERE b.date = #{date} AND b.status NOT IN ('CANCELLED') AND ( (b.start_time < #{endTime} AND b.end_time > #{startTime}) ) )
SELECT * FROM meeting_room WHERE location = #{location} AND status = 'AVAILABLE'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO meeting_room (name, location, capacity, equipment, status, description, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{name}, #{location}, #{capacity}, #{equipment}, #{status}, #{description}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE meeting_room SET name = #{name}, location = #{location}, capacity = #{capacity}, equipment = #{equipment}, status = #{status}, description = #{description}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
